# Evaluated match arms: a second wildcard is invalid, including after a prior match.
match 0 { _ => 7, _ => 8 } => error:duplicate match default
match 2 { 2 => 7, _ => 8, _ => 9 } => error:duplicate match default
match 9 { 1 => 1, _ => 8, 2 => 3, _ => 9 } => error:duplicate match default
match 0 { _ => 7 } => 7
match 1 { 1 => 7, _ => missing } => 7
match 2 { 1 => missing, _ => 8 } => 8
match 0 { 0 => match 1 { _ => 4 }, _ => 8 } => 4
match 0 { 1 => 3, 0 => 7 } => 7
match 1 { 0 => 3, 2 => 7 } => error:no matching match arm
match 0 { 0 => 5, _ => 1 + * } => error:expected integer
